responsibility: Implements gm2’s expandable bitmap set for symbol-number-like ordinals. A `Set` record tracks the valid lower bound, current allocated bitset storage, first and last occupied indices, and element count; operations grow the underlying byte buffer on demand up to `SymbolTable.FinalSymbol()`, map element numbers to `BITSET` slots, support copy and destruction, and provide membership, insertion, deletion, and ordered iteration facilities that other compiler modules use for worklists, dependency tracking, and symbol collections.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the implementation of the Sets interface: it defines the internal `Set` pointer record, bitmap allocation and doubling logic bounded by `SymbolTable.FinalSymbol()`, and the actual membership/update/iteration code, whereas `Sets.def` only exposes the API.
